scope: Only real papers in data/days, not demo papers or source watchlists. Countries are neutral geographic labels. Render city points on a land outline without national borders.
countingPolicy: Deduplicate stable paper IDs globally and once per selected geographic region; a cross-region paper belongs to each relevant region but is one global paper. Filter papers by active profile before counting; today means push-day date in Asia/Shanghai, not publication date.
